subject.title: feat(tasks): improve task state transitions and lifecycle formatting

question: Should OpenClaw persist and expose `awaiting_approval` and `waiting_external` as core task states, or should blocked-state detail remain derived presentation until an authoritative lifecycle contract exists?
rationale: This PR adds a cross-surface task-model capability and uses a text heuristic for one state transition; choosing the permanent state and event contract requires maintainer product and ownership judgment.

options.title: Sponsor an authoritative state model
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require explicit enter and recovery events, compatibility coverage, and a rebased narrow patch.

options.title: Keep blocked detail derived
options.body: Retain the existing coarse persisted task states and expose approval or external-wait detail only in presentation until the runtime emits a complete lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an authoritative state model
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require explicit enter and recovery events, compatibility coverage, and a rebased narrow patch.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete feature-history contact available in the supplied context; a current task-subsystem owner should be added during maintainer routing.
